notes: The jam band got a SOUND OVERHAUL. Prebuilt bands — Unplugged, Lounge, Organ trio, Rock club, Boom bap, Dream — set the whole rhythm section in one tap, then every piece is tweakable right in the mixer: 4 drum kits (Studio / 808 / 909 / Lo-fi, powered by the Studio engine's synth kit), bass tone (fingered / picked) moved into the mixer, and three NEW sampled comp instruments — grand piano, e-piano and organ — joining the guitars, keys and pad. Samples now pre-load when you open the Jam page so the first Play already sounds like the band. Also: Woodshed (the practice game) is now the FIRST pill in the Practice tab, and there's a new Windows desktop download (README) — a tiny installer that gives soundLAB its own desktop window with working MIDI.
